commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text:
Even while living the household life, those who bear the cruel words of people who have left the path are as pure as renouncers. Purity means a mind without stain. He says “mouths” to show how low a person is whose mouth is used to such words.

துறந்தாரின் can mean “like those who renounce” or “more than those who renounce”. He takes the first, and the plain reading follows him.
